worked_paragraphs.from: an06 Pacific Youth ch03 (2019, CC BY-NC-ND)
worked_paragraphs.aim: 지역 맥락(Wampar · ngaeng faring · Dzifasing) 제거 + 학술어 평이화
worked_paragraphs.before: to be held, primarily to raise funds for the costs of registration, which entails administrative, mapping and legal service expenses. It was a time of speculations, questions, imaginations, expectations and accommodations, but also of confrontations (Bacalzo et al. 2014), as locals, led by few but influential and competing ngaeng faring, began to organise themselves in relation to ideas of opportunities and problems. A new landowner association was formed with the intent to defend the interest in the mine in the name of all Wampar. This landowner association has been involved in costly court battles with other landowner associations from neighbouring non-Wampar groups over the ownership of the mining area, and they opened the membership to anybody living in the affected communities, provided that they paid an initial membership fee.
worked_paragraphs.after: Village meetings were held, mainly to raise money for the cost of registering the land. Registration meant paying for office work, map-making and legal advice. It was a time of guesswork, questions, hopes and bargaining, but also of open conflict. Villagers, led by a small number of powerful and rival elders, began to organise themselves around the chances and the dangers they saw ahead. A new landowners' group was formed to defend the villagers' share in the mine. That group has since fought expensive court cases against landowners' groups from neighbouring villages over who owns the mining area. It opened its membership to anyone living in the affected communities, as long as they paid a joining fee.

worked_paragraphs.from: an02 ‘My own sort of heaven’ ch03 (2024, CC BY-NC-ND)
worked_paragraphs.aim: 고유명사(Rosalie · New Zealand · WCTU) 제거 + 전기 서술 유지
worked_paragraphs.before: During these formative years, education was central to this part of Rosalie's life on two counts. School provided her with the stability and structure that may have been lacking at home. Also, New Zealand's policies and practices on domestic education for girls, based as they were on an idealised family, may have contributed to the feelings of being different, a misfit, an outsider, which she later talked about. Her family fell short of the ideal family promoted by the government and women's organisations such as the Women's Christian Temperance Union. In the longer term, the same policies shaped her thinking about a woman's role in home and family.
worked_paragraphs.after: In her childhood years, school mattered to her for two reasons. It gave her the steadiness and the routine that her home did not. At the same time, the rules the country set for teaching girls how to run a household assumed a perfect family, and that assumption may have fed her sense of being odd, out of place, an outsider, which she spoke about later in life. Her own family did not match the model that the government and the church-backed women's groups held up. In the long run, those same rules shaped what she believed a woman's place in the home should be.

worked_paragraphs.from: pb08 Reiner Schürmann and the Poetics of Politics (2018, CC BY-NC-SA)
worked_paragraphs.aim: 철학 고유명사(Plotinus · Aristotle)와 전문어(cataphatic · apophantic · archic · natality) 제거
worked_paragraphs.before: Here an echo of Aristotle is heard; for, as emphasized in chapter 2, Aristotle used the pronoun ti and the adverb pos to gesture to the indefiniteness at play in the being of the one. This is a language attentive to dispersion; it signals a heuristic of dysfunction - precisely there, where the limits of language are felt, something other than the conceptual shows itself. This happens only, however, as Plotinus risks a certain audacity: to articulate free willing in the one. Daring to speak cataphatically, Plotinus's language becomes apophantic, capable of showing that "originary audacity fractures archic simplicity." By following along with the words that seek to articulate free willing in the one, Plotinus brings the trait of mortality to language, indeed, suffers the "labor of mortality," and in so doing, shows the event of its discordant union with natality: the nuptial.
worked_paragraphs.after: An older thinker had already reached for the same device. To point at something that cannot be pinned down, he used the vaguest words his language offered - a bare "something," a bare "somehow." Such wording admits that it is scattering the idea rather than fixing it. That is its use: at the exact place where words give out, something that is not a concept shows itself. But this only works if the writer takes a risk. He has to stop saying what the thing is not and start saying, plainly, what it is, even though he knows the plain words are not permitted. The moment he does, his language stops being safe and starts being able to show. It carries into speech the fact that it will fail, and by failing it joins what is ending to what is beginning.

worked_paragraphs.from: pb07 Recovering the Radical Promise of Superheroes (2023, CC BY-NC-SA)
worked_paragraphs.aim: 프랜차이즈 고유명사(Zod · Krypton · Kryptonians · World Engine) 제거
worked_paragraphs.before: As newcomers, they have opted to colonize rather than assimilate, but a combination of breathing and sensory issues makes this difficult, hence the breather masks. And so, when General Zod issues the order to "Release the World Engine!" he marks the start of a nefarious plan to terraform, or terror-form, Earth and make a new Krypton. The World Engine works to alter Earth's underlying structure and its atmosphere. It will be up to the Kryptonians to change Earth's meaning from a human to a Kryptonian world. Moreover, by seeking to change Earth's present and future, the Kryptonians create the possibility of rewriting its past, likely erasing the human chapter of Earth's story completely, or trying to.
worked_paragraphs.after: The newcomers have chosen to take the planet over rather than fit into it, but trouble with breathing and with their senses makes that hard, which is why they wear masks. When their commander orders the great machine switched on, a plan begins: to reshape the ground and the air of the planet until it suits them instead of the people already living there. If the machine works, the meaning of the place changes hands. And a group that can decide a planet's present and future can also rewrite its past, erasing the earlier inhabitants from its story altogether.

g2.ngram_guard: 4/4 모두 6·7·8-gram 중복 0건 [측정: diffrate.mjs]. 즉 가공을 「고유명사 제거 + 평이화」 수준으로만 해도 산출물은 이미 G0-3 재저작 가드를 통과한다 — 가공과 재저작의 경계가 이 원천들에서는 거의 없다.

argument_survival.a1: 남는다. Wampar·ngaeng faring·Dzifasing 을 마을/장로/그 마을로 바꿔도 「등기 비용 → 지주 단체 결성 → 이웃 마을과 소유권 소송」 이라는 논지가 그대로 선다.
argument_survival.a2: 남는다. 인물 이름과 국명을 지워도 「학교가 집에 없던 안정을 주었다 / 이상적 가정을 전제한 교육정책이 이질감을 키웠다」 가 남는다. 다만 전기의 값어치인 **이 사람의 이야기**는 사라진다 — C 슬롯용으로 쓰려면 고유명사를 지우면 안 된다는 뜻이다.
argument_survival.p1: 거의 안 남는다. 문단 자체가 플로티노스·아리스토텔레스가 **어떤 낱말을 썼는가**에 대한 주석이다. 고유명사와 전문어를 걷으면 「말이 끝나는 자리에서 개념 아닌 것이 드러난다」 는 한 문장만 남고, 나머지는 새로 지어낸 것이다(수정량 83.0% · 삽입 82.9%).
argument_survival.p2: 남는다. 프랜차이즈 이름을 지워도 「이주자가 동화 대신 점령을 택한다 / 행성을 개조하면 현재·미래만이 아니라 과거까지 다시 쓸 수 있다」 는 논지가 선다. 다만 원문의 재미는 고유명사에 있었다.

r3_reauthoring_cost.why: criteria.md G0-2 에 따르면 NC·ND 원천은 표현을 못 쓴다. 따라서 여기서 재야 하는 것은 「가공 비용」이 아니라 **「논지 하나를 새 지문으로 바꾸는 비용」** 이다.
r3_reauthoring_cost.measured: 4문단 모두 한 문단 = 한 논지 = **재저작 지문 1편**(90~200어 창)이었다. 원문 문단 하나가 2편 이상을 내지 못했다 — 한 문단이 담는 주장이 하나이기 때문이다 [측정: 4/4].
r3_reauthoring_cost.chapter_level: 논증 표지를 가진 40어+ 문단 수가 재저작 입력의 상한이다: ANU 장당 7~40개(중앙 15) · punctum 권당(중앙 60% 구간) 0~210개(중앙 96.5) [측정: claimdensity].
r3_reauthoring_cost.caution: 이 상한은 **상한일 뿐**이다. 같은 장 안의 문단들은 같은 주장을 나눠 지니므로 실제 독립 지문 수는 훨씬 적다. 표본 4문단으로 권당 편수를 추정하는 것은 [추론]이라 판정에 쓰지 않는다.

limits: ANU Press 936권 전량의 라이선스를 세지 못했다. 편당 라이선스를 담은 API 가 없고(Crossref license facet 0 · DOAB dc.rights "open access" · OAPEN dc.rights.uri 12/175), 책 판권면은 PDF 안에만 있다. robots.txt 의 Crawl-delay 10 을 지키면 936권 확인에 최소 2.6시간이 걸린다 — 파일럿 범위를 넘어 하지 않았다. 대신 정책 문장 + 연도 분포로 **상한/하한**만 냈다.
연도 분포 519 : 300 은 Crossref 의 도서급 DOI 819건 기준이다. ANU 가 말하는 936권과 117권 차이가 나고, 그 차이는 DOI 없는 초기 ANU E Press 쪽일 가능성이 높다 — 그렇다면 ARR 비중은 실제로 더 높다. 확인 안 했다.
punctum 의 「452권」은 Thoth ACTIVE 도서급 472권 중 BY-NC-SA 의 수다. Thoth 에는 FORTHCOMING 76 · SUPERSEDED 5 · POSTPONED 3 · CANCELLED 1 이 더 있어 총 557 이다. 어느 수를 카탈로그 크기로 부를지는 정의 문제이므로 셋 다 적었다.
punctum 표본의 G3 는 전권 PDF 의 가운데 60% 페이지 구간이고, ANU 표본은 본문 장 하나다. 단위가 다르다 — 비율 지표(고유명사/100어 · 표지 비율 · keep_pct)는 비교 가능하지만 절대 산출량(yield)은 비교하면 안 된다.
G2 를 문단 4개에만 했다. criteria.md 는 원천마다 3문단을 요구한다 — 20권 × 3 = 60문단을 못 했다. 수정량 중앙값 70.4% 는 표본 4의 값이다.
「문단 자기완결성」은 표지 정규식 대리 지표다. criteria.md 가 요구하는 사람 판독은 4문단에만 했다. 20권의 argument_pct 수치를 사람 판독값처럼 쓰면 안 된다.
ANU an05 는 출판사 쪽 prelims 링크가 404 라 전권 PDF 에서 판권면을 읽었다. 본문 장은 정상 링크에서 받았다.
저자(author) 필드를 ANU 표본에 대해 구조화해 넣지 못했다. 책 판권면·표제지에 저자/편저자가 있다는 것은 확인했으나(G0-4 탈락 없음), HTML 파서가 이름을 못 떼어 냈다. punctum 은 Thoth contributions 에서 채웠다.
「지역 맥락 의존」은 상위 14개 고유명사를 육안 분류한 값이다. 전체 고유명사 질량의 분류가 아니다.
R3 재저작 산출량(원문 문단 1개 → 지문 몇 편)은 4문단에서 모두 1편이었다. 권당·장당 편수 추정은 하지 않았다 — 표본 4로 외삽하면 AGENTS.md 가 금지한 「일화 근거 권고」가 된다.
pb03(Kern)은 시각 타이포그래피 작품이라 PDF 에서 806어만 나온다. OCR 을 시도하지 않았다 — 이미지 자체가 글자 배열 작품이라 OCR 해도 산문이 아니다.
